description: This file defines the IUnknown interface and related proxy/stub classes for COM-like remote procedure call handling within the Thunder namespace. It includes class declarations for UnknownStub, UnknownStubType, UnknownProxy, and template proxy classes, along with associated methods for interface management, reference counting, and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations providing interface conversion and message handling.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub to handle specific interface and method dispatching.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing remote interface references, message invocation, and reference counting.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template proxy class implementing interface methods and delegating to UnknownProxy.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of methods or handlers in the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data pointer to the appropriate interface pointer.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID associated with the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Dispatches incoming messages to the appropriate method handler.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Acquires a reference to the remote interface, managing reference counts.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and handles cleanup when zero.

methods.name: RemoteInterface
methods.description: Retrieves a remote interface pointer by ID.

methods.name: Interface
methods.description: Returns an interface pointer for a given implementation and ID.

methods.name: ChannelId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated IPC channel.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for invoking a method on the remote interface.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message on the remote interface.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes a message exchange, updating reference counts and possibly deleting the parent object.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the interface or proxy.
